mapper.select: SELECT user_id, scope_id, binding_id, framework_session_id AS session_id, role FROM sq_runtime_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND framework_session_id = #{sessionId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sq_worker_job j JOIN sq_plan p ON p.task_id = j.task_id AND p.plan_version = j.plan_version WHERE j.user_id = #{userId} AND j.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND j.guard_token = #{guardToken} AND j.guard_lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT execution_id, user_id, scope_id, binding_id, request_hash, status, result_json FROM sq_sandbox_execution WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND (logical_key = #{logicalKey} OR (turn_id = #{turnId} AND tool_call_id = #{toolCallId})) FOR UPDATE
SELECT execution_id, user_id, scope_id, binding_id, request_hash, status, result_json FROM sq_sandbox_execution WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND execution_id = #{executionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_sandbox_execution (execution_id, user_id, scope_id, binding_id, logical_key, turn_id, tool_call_id, request_hash, status, deadline_at, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{userId}, #{scopeId}, #{bindingId}, #{logicalKey}, #{turnId}, #{toolCallId}, #{requestHash}, 'IN_FLIGHT', #{deadlineAt}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_sandbox_execution SET status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT'
mapper.select: SELECT execution_id, user_id, scope_id, binding_id, request_hash, status, result_json FROM sq_sandbox_execution WHERE status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND deadline_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_sandbox_execution SET status = 'UNKNOWN', last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND deadline_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
